```{r setup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)

  results = "markup"
)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

baseDir <- "/Users/tedwards/Documents/projects/VM_brainGutCoaching"

dataInputDir <- file.path(baseDir, "data/inputData")
```

# 1. Read raw data

```{r readSheet1}
excelFile <- file.path(dataInputDir, "BGCC Data Sheet 031626.xlsx")

# Row 1 is a merged header row (mostly empty); real headers are in row 2.
# Read without column names, then manually assign from row 2.
raw.df <- read.xlsx(excelFile, sheet = 1, colNames = FALSE, startRow = 1)

# Extract real column names from row 2 (which is row 1 after read, since
# openxlsx with colNames=FALSE reads everything as data)
# Row 1 = merged header junk, Row 2 = actual headers, Row 3+ = data
rawHeaders <- as.character(raw.df[2, ])
raw.df <- raw.df[3:nrow(raw.df), ]

cat("Raw dimensions:", nrow(raw.df), "rows x", ncol(raw.df), "cols\n")
cat("Raw headers from Excel row 2:\n")
cat(paste(seq_along(rawHeaders), rawHeaders, sep = ": "), sep = "\n")
```

```{r assignCleanColnames}
# Assign clean camelCase column names
cleanColNames <- c(
  "patientCode",          #  1 Patient Code #
  "classDate",            #  2 Class Date
  "referringProvider",    #  3 Referring Provider
  "age",                  #  4 Age at Time of Class
  "sex",                  #  5 Sex
  "dbgiDiagnoses",        #  6 DBGI Diagnos(es)
  "preOfficeVisits",      #  7 Pre-class Number of DBGI-related Office Visits
  "prePortalMessages",    #  8 Pre-class Number of DBGI-related Portal Messages
  "preTestsOrdered",      #  9 Pre-class Number of DBGI-related Tests Ordered
  "preERVisits",          # 10 Pre-class Number of DBGI-related ER visits
  "prePHQ2",              # 11 Pre-class PHQ-2 Score
  "preGAD7",              # 12 Pre-class GAD-7 Score
  "preIBSSSS",            # 13 Pre-class IBS Symptom Severity Score
  "postIBSSSS",           # 14 Post-class IBS Symptom Severity Score
  "deltaIBSSSS_raw",      # 15 Change in Symptom Severity Score (physician-computed)
  "postOfficeVisits",     # 16 Post-class Number of DBGI-related Office Visits
  "postPortalMessages",   # 17 Post-class Number of DBGI-related Portal Messages
  "postTestsOrdered",     # 18 Post-class Numer of DBGI-related Tests Ordered
  "postERVisits",         # 19 Post-class Number of DBGI-related ER visits
  "postPHQ2",             # 20 Post-class PHQ-2 Score
  "postGAD7",             # 21 Post-class GAD-7 Score
  "microGoals",           # 22 Micro-goals
  "goalFollowUp",         # 23 Goal Follow up
  "brainGutGamePlan",     # 24 Brain Gut Game Plan
  "surveyLiked",          # 25 What you liked
  "surveyImprovements",   # 26 Class Improvements
  "initialCodeLiked",     # 27 Initial Code- Liked
  "initialCodeImprove",   # 28 Initial Code- Improve
  "axialCodeLiked",       # 29 Axial Code- Liked
  "axialCodeImprove",     # 30 Axial Code- Improve
  "selectiveCoding"       # 31 Selective Coding
)

colnames(raw.df) <- cleanColNames
```

# 2. Type conversions

```{r convertTypes}
bgcc.df <- raw.df

# --- Patient code: keep as character ---
bgcc.df$patientCode <- trimws(as.character(bgcc.df$patientCode))

# --- Date conversion from Excel serial numbers ---
bgcc.df$classDate <- excelDateToR(bgcc.df$classDate)

# --- Factor columns ---
bgcc.df$sex <- factor(trimws(bgcc.df$sex))
bgcc.df$referringProvider <- factor(trimws(bgcc.df$referringProvider))

# --- Age: numeric ---
bgcc.df$age <- toNumericSafe(bgcc.df$age)

# --- Clinical scores: numeric, converting "Unknown"/"Unkown"/"Uknown" to NA ---
scoreCols <- c(
  "prePHQ2", "preGAD7", "preIBSSSS", "postIBSSSS", "deltaIBSSSS_raw",
  "postPHQ2", "postGAD7"
)
for (col in scoreCols) {
  bgcc.df[[col]] <- toNumericSafe(bgcc.df[[col]])
}

# --- Utilization counts: numeric ---
utilizationCols <- c(
  "preOfficeVisits", "prePortalMessages", "preTestsOrdered", "preERVisits",
  "postOfficeVisits", "postPortalMessages", "postTestsOrdered", "postERVisits"
)
for (col in utilizationCols) {
  bgcc.df[[col]] <- toNumericSafe(bgcc.df[[col]])
}

# --- Trim free-text columns ---
textCols <- c(
  "dbgiDiagnoses", "microGoals", "goalFollowUp", "brainGutGamePlan",
  "surveyLiked", "surveyImprovements",
  "initialCodeLiked", "initialCodeImprove",
  "axialCodeLiked", "axialCodeImprove"
)
for (col in textCols) {
  bgcc.df[[col]] <- trimws(as.character(bgcc.df[[col]]))
  bgcc.df[[col]][bgcc.df[[col]] == ""] <- NA
}

# --- Drop selectiveCoding (entirely NA) ---
bgcc.df$selectiveCoding <- NULL

cat("After type conversion:", nrow(bgcc.df), "rows x", ncol(bgcc.df), "cols\n")
```

```{r validateBasics}
# Sanity checks
cat("Unique patients:", length(unique(bgcc.df$patientCode)), "\n")
cat("Any duplicate patient codes:", any(duplicated(bgcc.df$patientCode)), "\n")
cat("Date range:", as.character(range(bgcc.df$classDate, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
cat("Age range:", range(bgcc.df$age, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Sex distribution:\n")
print(table(bgcc.df$sex, useNA = "always"))
```

# 3. Compute derived variables

```{r computeDerived}
# Recompute delta scores from source (don't trust pre-computed)
bgcc.df$deltaIBSSSS <- bgcc.df$postIBSSSS - bgcc.df$preIBSSSS
bgcc.df$deltaPHQ2 <- bgcc.df$postPHQ2 - bgcc.df$prePHQ2
bgcc.df$deltaGAD7 <- bgcc.df$postGAD7 - bgcc.df$preGAD7

# Healthcare utilization deltas
bgcc.df$deltaOfficeVisits <- bgcc.df$postOfficeVisits - bgcc.df$preOfficeVisits
bgcc.df$deltaPortalMessages <- bgcc.df$postPortalMessages - bgcc.df$prePortalMessages
bgcc.df$deltaERVisits <- bgcc.df$postERVisits - bgcc.df$preERVisits

# Severity bands
bgcc.df$preIBSSSSBand <- ibsSSSBand(bgcc.df$preIBSSSS)
bgcc.df$postIBSSSSBand <- ibsSSSBand(bgcc.df$postIBSSSS)
bgcc.df$preGAD7Band <- gad7Band(bgcc.df$preGAD7)
bgcc.df$postGAD7Band <- gad7Band(bgcc.df$postGAD7)
bgcc.df$prePHQ2Screen <- phq2Screen(bgcc.df$prePHQ2)
bgcc.df$postPHQ2Screen <- phq2Screen(bgcc.df$postPHQ2)

# Class month for temporal grouping
bgcc.df$classMonth <- format(bgcc.df$classDate, "%Y-%m")

# Survey response flag
bgcc.df$respondedToSurvey <- !(
  is.na(bgcc.df$surveyLiked) |
    tolower(bgcc.df$surveyLiked) == "did not respond"
)

# Count of diagnoses per patient (from free-text)
bgcc.df$nDiagnoses <- sapply(bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnoses, function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA_integer_)
  parts <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(x, ",")))
  parts <- parts[parts != ""]
  length(parts)
})

cat("Derived variables added. Final dimensions:", nrow(bgcc.df), "x", ncol(bgcc.df), "\n")
```

# 4. Parse and validate DBGI diagnoses

```{r parseDiagnoses}
# Read the one-hot diagnosis matrix from Sheet 7
diagOneHot.df <- read.xlsx(excelFile, sheet = 7, colNames = TRUE)

# Clean column names
diagColNames <- c(
  "dbgiDiagnoses",
  "IBS_C", "IBS_D", "IBS_M",
  "chronicIdiopathicConstipation", "functionalConstipation",
  "functionalDiarrhea", "cmAbdominalPainSyndrome",
  "functionalAbdominalPain", "functionalDyspepsia",
  "functionalBloating", "cyclicVomiting",
  "ruminationSyndrome", "idiopathicGastroparesis",
  "opioidInducedConstipation", "cannabinoidHyperemesis",
  "functionalHeartburn", "functionalNeurologicSyndrome"
)
colnames(diagOneHot.df) <- diagColNames

# Convert 1/NA to 1/0 for the one-hot columns
oneHotCols <- diagColNames[-1]
for (col in oneHotCols) {
  diagOneHot.df[[col]] <- ifelse(is.na(diagOneHot.df[[col]]), 0L, 1L)
}

# Sheet 7 has 199 rows — check if the last rows are the single-diagnosis labels
# (the last ~17 rows appear to be one row per diagnosis category)
cat("Sheet 7 rows:", nrow(diagOneHot.df), "\n")
cat("Last 20 diagnosis strings:\n")
print(tail(diagOneHot.df$dbgiDiagnoses, 20))
```

```{r matchDiagnosesToPatients}
# Sheet 7 has rows that are individual diagnosis category names at the bottom
# (e.g., "IBS-C", "IBS-D"). These are the diagnosis labels for the ad-hoc
# pie chart, not patient data. Filter to rows that match patient diagnosis combos.

# The main patient table has 183 patients. Sheet 7 likely has those 183 patient
# diagnosis rows plus some individual-diagnosis rows and maybe blank rows.
# Strategy: match by diagnosis string to the main table.

# Normalize diagnosis strings: trim whitespace, strip trailing commas,
# standardize case for matching
normalizeDiag <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- sub(",\\s*$", "", x)  # strip trailing comma
  x <- trimws(x)
  x
}

bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnosesNorm <- normalizeDiag(bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnoses)
diagOneHot.df$dbgiDiagnosesNorm <- normalizeDiag(diagOneHot.df$dbgiDiagnoses)

patientDiagStrings <- bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnosesNorm[!is.na(bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnosesNorm)]

# Identify rows in Sheet 7 that match a patient diagnosis string
diagOneHot.df$isPatientRow <- diagOneHot.df$dbgiDiagnosesNorm %in% patientDiagStrings

cat("\nSheet 7 patient rows:", sum(diagOneHot.df$isPatientRow), "\n")
cat("Sheet 7 non-patient rows:", sum(!diagOneHot.df$isPatientRow), "\n")
cat("Non-patient diagnosis strings:\n")
print(diagOneHot.df$dbgiDiagnoses[!diagOneHot.df$isPatientRow])
```

```{r buildCleanDiagMatrix}
# Keep only patient-matching rows from the one-hot matrix
# Note: diagnosis strings may repeat (multiple patients have "IBS-C").
# We need a UNIQUE row per diagnosis combination, then join to patients.

diagUniqueOneHot.df <- diagOneHot.df %>%
  filter(isPatientRow) %>%
  select(-isPatientRow) %>%
  distinct(dbgiDiagnosesNorm, .keep_all = TRUE)

cat("Unique diagnosis combinations:", nrow(diagUniqueOneHot.df), "\n")

# Join to main patient table on normalized diagnosis string
bgcc.df <- bgcc.df %>%
  left_join(diagUniqueOneHot.df %>% select(-dbgiDiagnoses), by = "dbgiDiagnosesNorm")

# Check join completeness
nMissingDiag <- sum(is.na(bgcc.df$IBS_C) & !is.na(bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnoses))
cat("Patients with diagnosis text but no one-hot match:", nMissingDiag, "\n")

if (nMissingDiag > 0) {
  unmatched <- bgcc.df %>%
    filter(is.na(IBS_C) & !is.na(dbgiDiagnoses)) %>%
    select(patientCode, dbgiDiagnoses, dbgiDiagnosesNorm)
  cat("Unmatched diagnosis strings:\n")
  print(unmatched)

  # Manual fix: "Functional Dyspepsia, Gastroparesis" — the free-text says
  # "Gastroparesis" but Sheet 7 uses "Idiopathic Gastroparesis".
  idx7588130 <- which(bgcc.df$patientCode == "7588130")
  if (length(idx7588130) == 1 && is.na(bgcc.df$IBS_C[idx7588130])) {
    bgcc.df[idx7588130, oneHotCols] <- 0L
    bgcc.df$functionalDyspepsia[idx7588130] <- 1L
    bgcc.df$idiopathicGastroparesis[idx7588130] <- 1L
    cat("Manually coded patient 7588130: functionalDyspepsia=1, idiopathicGastroparesis=1\n")
  }
  nMissingDiag <- sum(is.na(bgcc.df$IBS_C) & !is.na(bgcc.df$dbgiDiagnoses))
  cat("Remaining unmatched after manual fix:", nMissingDiag, "\n")
}
```

```{r validateDiagnosisOneHot}
# Cross-validate: for each patient, the sum of one-hot columns should equal nDiagnoses
bgcc.df$nDiagnosesOneHot <- rowSums(bgcc.df[, oneHotCols], na.rm = TRUE)

mismatch <- bgcc.df %>%
  filter(!is.na(dbgiDiagnoses)) %>%
  filter(nDiagnoses != nDiagnosesOneHot)

if (nrow(mismatch) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING:", nrow(mismatch), "patients with diagnosis count mismatch:\n")
  print(mismatch %>% select(patientCode, dbgiDiagnoses, nDiagnoses, nDiagnosesOneHot))
} else {
  cat("All diagnosis counts match between free-text and one-hot matrix.\n")
}
```

# 5. Reconcile with Stats sheet

```{r reconcileStats}
# Read Stats sheet (Sheet 6). It has 208 rows total (1 header + 184 patients + summary rows).
statsRaw.df <- read.xlsx(excelFile, sheet = 6, colNames = FALSE, startRow = 1)

# Real headers are in row 2 (same as Sheet1); patient data in rows 3–186.
# Identify patient rows: those with non-NA patient codes (col 1)
statsPatientRows <- which(!is.na(statsRaw.df[, 1]) & statsRaw.df[, 1] != "Patient Code #")
# Exclude the header row which is row 2
statsPatientRows <- statsPatientRows[statsPatientRows >= 3]

cat("Stats sheet patient rows:", length(statsPatientRows), "\n")
cat("Sheet1 patient rows:", nrow(bgcc.df), "\n")

# Check if Stats has 2 extra patients vs Sheet1
statsCodes <- trimws(as.character(statsRaw.df[statsPatientRows, 1]))
sheet1Codes <- bgcc.df$patientCode

extraInStats <- setdiff(statsCodes, sheet1Codes)
extraInSheet1 <- setdiff(sheet1Codes, statsCodes)

if (length(extraInStats) > 0) {
  cat("Patient codes in Stats but not Sheet1:", paste(extraInStats, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
if (length(extraInSheet1) > 0) {
  cat("Patient codes in Sheet1 but not Stats:", paste(extraInSheet1, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Check if Stats has different utilization data (cols 7-8 look different in Stats)
# Stats may have NAs where Sheet1 has values — or vice versa. Compare.
cat("\nSheet1 preOfficeVisits NAs:", sum(is.na(bgcc.df$preOfficeVisits)), "\n")

# Read Stats utilization columns for the matching patients to compare
statsUtil <- statsRaw.df[statsPatientRows, c(1, 7, 8, 10, 16, 17, 19)]
colnames(statsUtil) <- c("patientCode", "statsPreOffice", "statsPrePortal",
  "statsPreER", "statsPostOffice", "statsPostPortal", "statsPostER")
statsUtil$patientCode <- trimws(as.character(statsUtil$patientCode))
for (col in colnames(statsUtil)[-1]) {
  statsUtil[[col]] <- toNumericSafe(statsUtil[[col]])
}

cat("Stats preOfficeVisits NAs:", sum(is.na(statsUtil$statsPreOffice)), "\n")

# If Stats has MORE missing utilization data, Sheet1 is the better source.
# If Stats has LESS, we should prefer those values.
# For now, stick with Sheet1 as primary (as planned).
```

# 6. Thematic coding from Consensus Review

```{r readConsensusReview}
# Read Consensus Review (Sheet 4)
consRaw.df <- read.xlsx(excelFile, sheet = 4, colNames = FALSE, startRow = 1)

# Row 1 is merged header row, row 2 is sub-headers, row 3+ is data
# Inspect structure
cat("Consensus Review raw dimensions:", nrow(consRaw.df), "x", ncol(consRaw.df), "\n")

# The structure from inspection:
# [1] "What you liked" survey text
# [2] "Initial Code- Liked"
# [3] "Sub-Themes"
# [4-6] Overall Themes: "Positive Shared Experience", "Educational Environment...", "Patient Activation"
# [7-12] Subthemes 1: Isolation Reduced, Validation, Shared community,
#        Change from neg healthcare experiences, Gratitude, Enjoyment/Positive Experience
# [13-15] Subthemes 2: Content, Teaching/Coaching style, Coaching structure
# [16-18] Subthemes 3: Self-Efficacy, Agency Knowledge/skills, Agency (actionable tools)

# Row 2 has the sub-column headers
subHeaders <- as.character(consRaw.df[2, ])
cat("Consensus Review sub-headers:\n")
for (j in 1:ncol(consRaw.df)) cat(sprintf("  [%2d] %s\n", j, subHeaders[j]))
```

```{r cleanConsensusReview}
# Extract data rows (row 3 onward)
consData.df <- consRaw.df[3:nrow(consRaw.df), ]

# Assign clean column names
consColNames <- c(
  "surveyLiked",                  # 1
  "initialCodeLiked",             # 2
  "subThemes",                    # 3
  "themePositiveSharedExperience", # 4
  "themePatientEmpowerment",      # 5
  "themePatientActivation",       # 6
  "subIsolationReduced",          # 7
  "subValidation",                # 8
  "subSharedCommunity",           # 9
  "subChangeNegHealthcare",       # 10
  "subGratitude",                 # 11
  "subEnjoymentPositive",         # 12
  "subContent",                   # 13
  "subTeachingCoachingStyle",     # 14
  "subCoachingStructure",         # 15
  "subSelfEfficacy",              # 16
  "subAgencyKnowledgeSkills",     # 17
  "subAgencyActionableTools"      # 18
)
colnames(consData.df) <- consColNames

# Convert binary theme/subtheme columns: "1" -> 1, NA or anything else -> 0
binaryThemeCols <- consColNames[4:18]
for (col in binaryThemeCols) {
  vals <- trimws(as.character(consData.df[[col]]))
  consData.df[[col]] <- ifelse(!is.na(vals) & vals == "1", 1L, 0L)
}

# Trim text columns
for (col in consColNames[1:3]) {
  consData.df[[col]] <- trimws(as.character(consData.df[[col]]))
  consData.df[[col]][consData.df[[col]] == ""] <- NA
  consData.df[[col]][consData.df[[col]] == "NA"] <- NA
}

# The Consensus Review doesn't have patient codes directly.
# It has the same row order as Sheet1 (183 patients).
# Add patient codes from the main table.
if (nrow(consData.df) >= nrow(bgcc.df)) {
  consData.df <- consData.df[1:nrow(bgcc.df), ]
  consData.df$patientCode <- bgcc.df$patientCode
} else {
  cat("WARNING: Consensus Review has fewer rows than main table.\n")
  consData.df$patientCode <- bgcc.df$patientCode[1:nrow(consData.df)]
}

cat("Consensus Review cleaned:", nrow(consData.df), "rows\n")
cat("Patients with >=1 theme coded:",
  sum(rowSums(consData.df[, binaryThemeCols]) > 0), "\n")

cat("\nTheme prevalence:\n")
for (col in binaryThemeCols) {
  cat(sprintf("  %-35s: %d (%.1f%%)\n",
    col, sum(consData.df[[col]]),
    100 * mean(consData.df[[col]])))
}
```

# 7. Check pre/post Tests Ordered columns

```{r checkTestsOrdered}
cat("preTestsOrdered NAs:", sum(is.na(bgcc.df$preTestsOrdered)), "of", nrow(bgcc.df), "\n")
cat("postTestsOrdered NAs:", sum(is.na(bgcc.df$postTestsOrdered)), "of", nrow(bgcc.df), "\n")

}
```

# 8. Missingness summary

```{r missingSummary, results="markup"}
# Count missing values per column
missingReport.df <- data.frame(
  variable = colnames(bgcc.df),
  nMissing = sapply(bgcc.df, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  pctMissing = sapply(bgcc.df, function(x) round(100 * mean(is.na(x)), 1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
missingReport.df <- missingReport.df %>% arrange(desc(pctMissing))

cat("=== Missingness Report ===\n")
print(missingReport.df %>% filter(pctMissing > 0), row.names = FALSE)

# Key analytic sample sizes
cat("\n=== Analytic sample sizes ===\n")
cat("Total patients:", nrow(bgcc.df), "\n")
cat("Pre IBS-SSS available:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$preIBSSSS)), "\n")
cat("Post IBS-SSS available:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$postIBSSSS)), "\n")
cat("Paired IBS-SSS (both pre & post):",
  sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$preIBSSSS) & !is.na(bgcc.df$postIBSSSS)), "\n")
cat("Pre PHQ-2 available:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$prePHQ2)), "\n")
cat("Post PHQ-2 available:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$postPHQ2)), "\n")
cat("Paired PHQ-2:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$prePHQ2) & !is.na(bgcc.df$postPHQ2)), "\n")
cat("Pre GAD-7 available:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$preGAD7)), "\n")
cat("Post GAD-7 available:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$postGAD7)), "\n")
cat("Paired GAD-7:", sum(!is.na(bgcc.df$preGAD7) & !is.na(bgcc.df$postGAD7)), "\n")
cat("Survey respondents:", sum(bgcc.df$respondedToSurvey), "\n")
```

# 9. Export clean data

```{r exportCleanData}
# Ensure output directory exists
if (!dir.exists(dataOutputDir)) dir.create(dataOutputDir, recursive = TRUE)

# Main patient table
saveRDS(bgcc.df,
  file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_bgccClean.rds")))
write.csv(bgcc.df,
  file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_bgccClean.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE)

# Thematic coding table
saveRDS(consData.df,
  file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_thematicCoding.rds")))
write.csv(consData.df,
  file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_thematicCoding.csv")),
  row.names = FALSE)

# Diagnosis one-hot matrix (unique combos only)
saveRDS(diagUniqueOneHot.df,
  file.path(dataOutputDir, paste0(filenameSuffix, "_diagnosisOneHot.rds")))

cat("Clean data exported to:", dataOutputDir, "\n")
cat("Files:\n")
cat("  ", paste0(filenameSuffix, "_bgccClean.rds/.csv"), "\n")
cat("  ", paste0(filenameSuffix, "_thematicCoding.rds/.csv"), "\n")
cat("  ", paste0(filenameSuffix, "_diagnosisOneHot.rds"), "\n")
```
